definitions.explanation: A tall plant with large yellow flowers that turn to follow the sun.

examples.english: Sunflower fields are popular photo spots in summer, and many people come to see them every year.

notes:
The name {向日葵|ひまわり} means 'facing the sun' (⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧ + ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ + ⟦{葵|あおい}→葵：noentry⟧), referring to the flower's heliotropic behavior (following the sun). Also written as ヒマワリ.

Symbolism:
- Summer (⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧)
- Brightness, energy, vitality
- Admiration, loyalty (turning toward the sun)

Products from sunflowers:
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ (sunflower seeds - snack)
- ひまわり⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (sunflower oil)

Famous sunflower locations:
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦{北竜町|ほくりゅうちょう}→北竜町：noentry⟧
- Various {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (sunflower fields) across Japan

The 1970 film 「ひまわり」 (Sunflower) starring Sophia Loren features an iconic sunflower field scene shot in Ukraine.
